name: single positive weight always selects its value
input: one choice, or zero weights on either side

name: zero-weight entries never appear among multiple positive choices
test:
import random
random.seed(429)
sampler=WeightedSampler(['zero1','a','zero2','b','zero3'],[0,2,0,3,0])
draws=[sampler.sample() for _ in range(2000)]
assert set(draws)=={'a','b'},'zero-weight or unknown value returned, or a positive-weight value never sampled'

name: observed proportions follow unequal fractional weights
test:
import random
from collections import Counter
random.seed(42901)
sampler=WeightedSampler(['a','b','c'],[0.125,0.375,0.5])
n=12000;counts=Counter(sampler.sample() for _ in range(n))
assert set(counts)=={'a','b','c'}
for value,expected in [('a',0.125),('b',0.375),('c',0.5)]:
    assert abs(counts[value]/n-expected)<0.04,(value,counts)

name: fresh sampling permits repeats and varied transitions
input: balanced draws should neither be cached nor alternate mechanically
test:
import random
random.seed(42902)
sampler=WeightedSampler([10,20],[1,1]);n=8000
draws=[sampler.sample() for _ in range(n)]
assert set(draws)=={10,20}
assert abs(draws.count(10)/n-0.5)<0.05
same=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(draws,draws[1:]))/(n-1)
assert 0.4<same<0.6,'draws appear cached, alternating, or strongly correlated'

name: skewed distribution still samples the rare positive-weight entry
test:
import random
from collections import Counter
random.seed(42903)
sampler=WeightedSampler(['zero','rare','common'],[0,1,99])
counts=Counter(sampler.sample() for _ in range(20000))
assert counts['zero']==0
assert 80<counts['rare']<320,counts
assert counts['rare']+counts['common']==20000
